details.summary: Sells mob loot for emeralds, for worlds where the mob that drops it never appears.

sections.title: Bone
sections.text: Normally dropped by bogged, parched, skeletons, skeleton horses, strays and wither skeletons; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Creeper Head
sections.text: Normally dropped by a creeper killed in a charged creeper explosion; creepers do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Music Disc (Lava Chicken)
sections.text: Normally dropped by a baby zombie or husk riding a chicken when a player kills it; zombies and husks do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Phantom Membrane
sections.text: Normally dropped by phantoms; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Prismarine Crystals
sections.text: Normally dropped by elder guardians and guardians; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Prismarine Shard
sections.text: Normally dropped by elder guardians and guardians; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Resin Clump
sections.text: Normally harvested from the heart of a creaking, which a player hits at night; creakings do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Rotten Flesh
sections.text: Normally dropped by camel husks, drowned, husks, zoglins, zombies, zombie horses, zombified piglins and zombie villagers; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Skeleton Skull
sections.text: Normally dropped by a skeleton killed in a charged creeper explosion; creepers do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Spider Eye
sections.text: Normally dropped by cave spiders, spiders and witches; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: String
sections.text: Normally dropped by cave spiders and spiders; they do not appear on Peaceful. It is sold as a deliberate exception: string matters early, and its only early source on Peaceful is a cat gift.

sections.title: Tide Armor Trim Smithing Template
sections.text: Normally dropped by elder guardians, which are monument guardians that do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Trident
sections.text: Normally dropped by drowned; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Zombie Head
sections.text: Normally dropped by a zombie killed in a charged creeper explosion; creepers do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Music Discs (creeper)
sections.text: The twelve discs a creeper drops when a skeleton-type mob kills it: 11, 13, Blocks, Cat, Chirp, Far, Mall, Mellohi, Stal, Strad, Wait and Ward. Creepers and skeletons do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Not sold: wet sponge
sections.text: Wet sponge is left out. Its main source is the sponge rooms of ocean monuments, and elder guardians cannot be farmed even in normal play, so the machine would only duplicate that structure loot.

details.summary: Sells mob loot for emeralds, for worlds where the mob that drops it never appears.

sections.title: Blaze Rod
sections.text: Normally dropped by blazes; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Ghast Tear
sections.text: Normally dropped by ghasts; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Music Disc (Tears)
sections.text: Normally dropped by a ghast killed by its own fireball, which a player reflected; ghasts do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Ochre Froglight
sections.text: Normally made when a temperate frog eats a tiny magma cube; magma cubes do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Pearlescent Froglight
sections.text: Normally made when a warm frog eats a tiny magma cube; magma cubes do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Piglin Head
sections.text: Normally dropped by a piglin killed in a charged creeper explosion; creepers do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Verdant Froglight
sections.text: Normally made when a cold frog eats a tiny magma cube; magma cubes do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Wither Skeleton Skull
sections.text: Normally dropped by wither skeletons; they do not appear on Peaceful. The skull is sold as a decorative item, since the Wither cannot be summoned there.

details.summary: Sells mob loot for emeralds, for worlds where the mob that drops it never appears.

sections.title: Breeze Rod
sections.text: Normally dropped by breezes; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Ominous Bottle
sections.text: Normally dropped by pillagers; they do not appear on Peaceful. The bottle is sold as a decorative item.

sections.title: Ominous Trial Key
sections.text: Normally ejected as a reward by a completed ominous trial spawner; trial spawners do not spawn mobs on Peaceful, so they are never completed.

sections.title: Totem of Undying
sections.text: Normally dropped by evokers; they do not appear on Peaceful.

sections.title: Trial Key
sections.text: Normally ejected as a reward by a completed trial spawner; trial spawners do not spawn mobs on Peaceful, so they are never completed.

sections.title: Trial keys instead of spawner rewards
sections.text: Trial spawners do not spawn mobs on Peaceful, so the machine sells their trial and ominous trial keys in place of the reward. The other rewards, such as food, potions and wind charges, are found elsewhere or can be crafted.

details.summary: Sells mob loot for emeralds, for worlds where the mob that drops it never appears.

sections.title: Nether Star
sections.text: Normally dropped by the Wither; it cannot be summoned on Peaceful.

sections.title: Wither Rose
sections.text: Normally left behind where the Wither kills a mob or player; the Wither cannot be summoned on Peaceful, so this rose is decorative here.
